body: on the back: “before sunday's rain, a cloying orchard smell in the weathered bundle after the livestock supplement test. my sister coughed all night. later, warning tape went up.”
title: weathered bundle note — before sunday's rain
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the a cloying orchard smell while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.

title: The dance list
body: We counted people for a ride home by the pairs on the dance card. The driver was instructed to use the official total, two fewer than ours. He asked the two without partners to stand by the road until another truck came.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
